name: Disturbed Friends
summary: Party voting game where players guess how the active player will answer provocative questions.
rules_text: Shuffle Question Cards and Winning Cards into separate decks. Each player takes one set of Voting Cards (A/B). On your turn you are the Decider: draw a Question Card and read it aloud. It presents a disturbing scenario with two options. Other players secretly choose the option they think you will pick and place their Voting Card face down. Once all have voted, you announce your own actual choice. All votes are revealed. Each player who correctly predicted your choice gains one Winning Card from the deck. Discard the Question Card. Play passes clockwise. The first player to collect 10 Winning Cards wins. If multiple reach 10 on same turn, the player with most Winning Cards among them wins, or tied players share victory.
rating_reason: Voting guess-your-answer party game; hidden votes, opponent modeling, fully textable.
